title: APCNV-2024-7726-VZC-ADJ-HCA
text:
APCNV-2024-7726-VZC-ADJ-HCA  Council District: 7 – Rodriguez
  CEQA: ENV-2024-7727-SE  Last Day to Act: 08-20-26
  Plan Area: Mission Hills – Panorama City – North Hills  Continued from: 07-16-26

  PUBLIC HEARING – Completed May 26, 2026

  PROJECT SITE:  9236 North Burnet Avenue

  The Applicant is requesting that this matter be continued to a date certain of August 20, 2026.

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Demolition of an existing single-family residence for the construction of four two-story multifamily residential
  duplexes with attached two-car garages, one garage per dwelling unit on a 22,869.8 gross square foot lot.
  The housing development will consist of eight dwelling units and 16 parking spaces. The units will range
  from 1,370 square feet to 1,534 square feet and have a maximum height of 30 feet, six inches.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to California Public Resource Code Section 21080.66 (AB 130), a Statutory Exemption from
  the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA);
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1A Section 13B.1.4.I and Chapter 1 Section 12.32 Q of the Los Angeles Municipal
  Code (LAMC), a Vesting Zone Change from the RA-1 (Residential Suburban Zone) to (Q)(T)RD3-1
  (Restricted Density Multiple Dwelling Zone); and
  3. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.5.2 and Chapter 1 Section 12.28 A, an Adjustment to
  permit a less than 20 percent reduction in minimum lot area per dwelling unit or guest room for a total
  of eight-units in lieu of the otherwise seven-units that would be permitted under the proposed RD3
  Zone pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.09.1 B.4.

  Applicant:  Henry Wang, Vibehen Property, LLC
  Representative: Eric Lieberman, QES, Inc.

  Staff:  Shane Strunk, Planning Assistant
  shane.strunk@lacity.org
  (213) 675-6022
